title: North Carolina county income, rent burden, and commute estimates, 2024 ACS 5-year

definitions.income: Median household income in past 12 months, 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars. Margin of error is the published ACS 90% MOE.
definitions.rent_burden: Share of renter-occupied units paying gross rent of at least 30% of household income, excluding units where ratio was not computed. Gross rent includes contract rent plus utilities/fuels.
definitions.commute: Share of workers age 16+ who did not work from home and traveled 30 minutes or longer to work. This is commute time, not financial cost of commuting.
definitions.uncertainty: Published component 90% margins of error are included. Derived-share MOEs were not calculated; differences between counties or years should not be treated as statistically meaningful without a proper MOE calculation.
